## Summary

Describe the change and why it helps students.

## Change type

- [ ] New offer
- [ ] Offer correction
- [ ] Ended or replaced offer
- [ ] Region or eligibility update
- [ ] Billing or renewal warning
- [ ] Documentation or repository maintenance

## Evidence checklist

- [ ] I linked an official provider or authoritative program source.
- [ ] I checked the source on the date shown in the catalog.
- [ ] I verified benefit, duration, eligibility, region, and verification method.
- [ ] I verified card and auto-renewal behavior or marked it unknown.
- [ ] I removed referral, affiliate, tracking, and user-specific URL parameters.
- [ ] I did not include private student or account information.
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md` for a material change.
- [ ] I checked affected relative links and Markdown formatting.
